Designer Michael Braun tells Danny Jones how he dressed Jimi Hendrix and Macho Man Randy Savage. Braun created stage clothes for rock gods and ring kings in their wildest eras. His tale threads together music, wrestling, and the craft of making a legend look the part.

Braun shares stories of fittings, tours, and the demands of two very different kinds of star. He explains how a jacket or a robe becomes part of a performer's power. Jones, a fan of both worlds, draws out the best backstage details. Fashion fans and the nostalgic get threads of legend from the man who sewed them.
